title: Principal at Data and AI Services Provider Expects Strong Snowflake Services Growth Amid Rising AI Demand
expert: Principal solution architect at a North American data and AI services provider
verdict: The architect sees Snowflake client contracts up roughly at least 20% y/y as usage beats plan and AI adds spend [[1 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse28114&hl=fse28114,fse28323,fse29030,fse29088&page=2), with Cortex Code on over 90% of clients [[9 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse40577&hl=fse40577,fse46551,fse47330&page=2).

Demand / orders: 🟢 client contracts +≥~20% y/y as usage exceeds plan, vs ACV +7%–8% (2026-11-05): higher. → Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration) ↑ [[1 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse28114&hl=fse28114,fse28323,fse29030,fse29088&page=2)

🟢 services +25%–30% in 2026, 2027 at least the same (estimates), vs 14%–15% (2026-11-05): higher. [[8 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse21734&hl=fse21734,fse25388,fse25454,fse25523&page=2)

🟢 Cortex Code on >90% of clients vs ~40% (2026-11-05) and KeyBanc's ~50% of active users (SB #61004): higher. → Tenet 2 (AI second engine) ↑ [[9 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse40577&hl=fse40577,fse46551,fse47330&page=2)
Pricing & margins: 🔴 pricing is the biggest hindrance; no all-you-can-eat AI given model-provider passthrough costs, consistent with the FY27 product GM cut to 74% (SB #50180). → Tenet 4 (margins expand) ↓ [[10 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse7599&hl=fse7599,fse14661,fse14841,fse44962&page=2) [[12 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse29563&hl=fse29563,fse29634,fse29896,fse30072&page=2)
Competition & share: 🟡 Databricks gaining on flexibility and in-house skills; BigQuery losing on features. → Tenet 3 (control point) → [[6 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse32058&hl=fse32058,fse32096&page=2) [[7 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270037&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse32429&hl=fse32429,fse32574&page=2)

changes: Cortex Code >90% of clients vs ~40% (2026-11-05) and KeyBanc ~50% of active users (SB #61004): higher.
AI passthrough costs limit pricing vs FY27 product GM guide cut to 74% on AI mix (SB #50180): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration): ↑ — contracts +≥~20% as usage exceeds plan.
Tenet 2 (AI second engine): ↑ — Cortex Code on >90% of clients; AI materiality 8+/10.
Tenet 3 (governed-data control point): → — Databricks gaining on flexibility, BigQuery losing.
Tenet 4 (margins expand): ↓ — model-provider passthrough costs rule out all-you-can-eat AI pricing.
